Interpretation\\r\\n\\r\\n### 1.4  Precedence between instruments\\r\\n  \\r\\nWhere two or more instruments address the same asset, the order of precedence is: (a) a Technical Service Bulletin that names the serial range of the asset; (b) the Regional Addendum for the region in which the asset is installed; (c) this policy. ## C-2026-04103 — coverage and payable

**Position:** **Covered**, on the current evidence, as a **Standard warranty claim** (not TSB-funded).

**Total payable: INR 19,150**

### Coverage rationale

- The claim concerns serial **CIE-2200-AC-00320**, an India asset, repaired on **22 April 2026** under operation **SEAL-KIT-RR**. It was submitted on **28 April 2026**, within the partner agreement’s 30-day submission window.
- Under **India addendum A1**, coverage is **18 months from commissioning or 5,000 running hours, whichever occurs first**; that overrides the global default of 24 months/6,000 hours.
- The asset was commissioned on **2 May 2025**, so the time limit runs to **2 November 2026**. The latest reading at or before repair was **2,750 hours**, dated 2 April 2026. The 22 April repair therefore falls within both the time and hours limits.
- **TSB-P-0115 does not govern.** Although the index flags the serial as in range, the actual bulletin is **EMEA-only** and concerns extended drive-train coverage. This is an **India seal-kit repair**, and the bulletin document controls over the non-authoritative index.

### Payable calculation

| Element | Calculation | Payable |
|---|---:|---:|
| Labour | 3.0 hours × INR 1,450/hour | **INR 4,350** |
| Part P-22120 (seal kit) | Current list price of part actually fitted | **INR 14,800** |
| Parts handling uplift | 0% under SPA-2023-FAB-IN | **INR 0** |
| **Total** | 4,350 + 14,800 | **INR 19,150** |

The claimed 3.0 labour hours equal the flat-rate allowance for SEAL-KIT-RR, so all 3.0 hours are payable. The service record confirms that **P-22120** was actually fitted, and its applicable INR list price is **14,800**. No handling uplift is allowed under the service partner agreement.

### Governing basis

- **India addendum A1** — coverage period.
- **Global Warranty Policy clauses 4.1–4.3** — labour, parts pricing, and handling uplift.
- **SPA-2023-FAB-IN** — no parts uplift and 30-day claim-submission requirement.
- **Funding code:** **Standard**, not TSB.

### Caveat

Seals can be excluded as consumables if an inspection report establishes that the work was routine scheduled maintenance. No such report or exclusion evidence was available in the records reviewed, so the covered position is based on the current evidence.

I have **not** recorded an adjudication in the claim system. The recommended next step is to record approval under the **Standard** funding code for **INR 19,150**, subject to rechecking if an inspection report later shows routine maintenance.
